reason: Give each project its own homepage entrance and distinguish those worlds from the corpus reading paths.
extension: Register another PublishedMicrosite only when its microsite has a published landing page. The homepage renders the catalog; no additional homepage rendering policy is required.
boundaries: Homepage project entries each link only to their microsite.
Claimipedia contains an executable fictional comparison; it does not imply the full production platform is deployed.
The corpus gate follows topics, research and encounters, rather than acting as a second project directory.
The seven original project names remain recorded as provenance; reading-path labels do not define future microsite identities.
stylesheetVersion: The shared stylesheet reference includes site.stylesheetVersion. Increment that REL value whenever shared styles change so returning visitors receive the matching CSS.

entrances.icons: Four original transparent raster illustrations in assets/world-emblems, bound by REL and rendered as decorative images.
entrances.presentation: Distinct gold, rose, sage and blue light; decorative orbital backgrounds; explanatory copy and native anchor cards.
entrances.worldwright: worldwright/index.html is an explicitly labelled placeholder for the storytelling and authoring product.
checks: Desktop two-column and mobile single-column layout
No horizontal overflow at 390 CSS pixels
Keyboard Enter follows the Worldwright card
Reduced-motion CSS removes card animation and movement
entrances.motion: Finite hover and keyboard-focus transitions: card lift, moving highlight, orbital glow and a distinct emblem tilt/lift per world. Reduced-motion preferences disable transforms and transitions.
entrances.positioning: Lead with the software, governing philosophy and scope. A separate illustration line introduces each bounded demo. Corpus check and source hashes: source/purpose-edition.json.

sharing.authoring: Run node tooling/author-social-sharing.mjs after the page authoring helpers; then run the normal algebra build.

capabilities.authoring: tooling/author-capabilities.mjs (also run by Encounter and world-entrance authoring)
capabilities.projection: Smaller second list through frontdoors.home, separate from PublishedMicrosite product cards.
capabilities.destinations: Encounter links to its live example. Other entries link to existing reading paths or scenes; they do not imply separate deployed products.
